strategy.offer: Full-service e-commerce services: online shop creation, customization, maintenance, hosting, analytics, conversion improvement, search marketing, social media, and marketplace or price-portal integration.
strategy.customers: Online merchants and businesses building, relaunching, operating, or improving digital shops, from smaller firms to larger companies.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues clients benefit from combining shop technology, marketing, usability, analytics, and support in tailored, transparent, measurable services focused on sales results.
strategy.resources: Basis includes experienced specialists, certified developers and marketers, project and design experience across many shops, plugin and interface development, structured support processes, and partner networks.
